name: pinball-play
note: A person's start: Play on the title, the table select (the table last played) with South, the plunger held a second and let go, then the flippers on the shoulders and the d-pad: two presses from the title to the plunger (game.launches 1). The ball's whole path (game.hash) must be the same bits on every host. The control never pulls the plunger.

name: pinball-face
note: The face buttons alone in play, through the real pad path: west the left flipper, east the right, both together, south both once the ball is up (a fresh press), short taps of each, north a nudge. Every press is a flip (game.flips) and the game is the same bits natively and in the dual cart on romdev. The control plays the same start and nudge with no face-button flips: its flips and ball path differ, so it must fail.

name: pinball-restart
note: The pause menu's Restart game on the pad alone: a person's start (title, table, plunger, a launch, flips), Start, down to Restart game, accept: the same table from its first ball, the plunger loaded and nothing launched yet. The control accepts Resume instead, so the launch stands. Frames within 0.25% (the lamps lit at the restart differ by a few edge pixels between the native and cart renderers: 0.10% measured).

name: pinball-change-table
note: The pause menu's Change table on the pad alone: the same start, Start, down twice, accept: back on the table select. The control accepts Resume, so the game goes on.
